{{Quote|This keeps the surepp contented and together after dark, while outriders like myself keep shanhs and others away from the corral. The surepp cannot leap over the barrier, but a hungry shanh could.|Bayaar|<ref name="AS">''[[The Approaching Storm]]''</ref>}}
'''Shanhs''' were a [[Species/Legends|species]] of fiercely predatory animals native to [[Ansion/Legends|Ansion]]. They were characterized by their three red eyes, six legs that ended with clawed paws, and striped skins. The shanhs typically hunted in packs, roaming their [[Planet/Legends|world's]] grassy plains by night. The tribal [[Alwari]] often made clothing out of their tanned hides.<ref name="AS" />

In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[The Approaching Storm]]'' to [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]].</ref> Jedi [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and [[Luminara Unduli/Legends|Luminara Unduli]], during a nighttime watch on the Ansion plains, fought with the creatures. Later, following a [[lorqual]] stampede into his camp, the Jedi team's obese [[Qulun]] captor [[Baiuntu]] was killed by a rabbidly agitated shanh pack.<ref name="AS" />
